1.why: Body copy throughout (e.g., 'Use the trusted demo credentials to begin MFA enrolment.') is a clean sans-serif with ample line height, although the Logs panel uses small dense monospace type.

2.why: Instructions are sentence-case with no italics and no all-caps (e.g., 'Use a code if your authenticator is unavailable…'); the only all-caps text is the NORTHSTAR BANK brand header.

3.why: The single-column mobile-width layout with full-width buttons and wrapped paragraphs stays readable in every screenshot.

4.why: Each step gives a one- or two-sentence instruction, though jargon such as 'provisioning representation' and 'manual secret' slightly undermines plain language.

5.why: Only the recovery-code field shows a format example via its 'ABCD-EFGH-JKLM' placeholder, while the verification-code and authenticator-code inputs show no example of the expected six-digit input.

6.why: The user must extract every code from the ever-growing dense monospace Logs panel (eight-plus lines by step_17) and parse the long wrapped otpauth string in order to proceed.

7.why: No copy affordance exists on any screen, and step_04 explicitly instructs the user to 'enter this in your authenticator', so the 32-character secret must be transcribed by hand.

8.why: Although step_04 says 'scan the provisioning value', only a text otpauth URI and a manual secret are offered; no QR code or scannable equivalent appears anywhere.

9.why: The login uses a conventional masked password input that password managers can usually fill, but nothing demonstrates autocomplete attributes or one-time-code autofill for the OTP fields.

10.why: Headings and a prominent green button mark each step, but there is no progress indicator and by step_17 eight stacked 'Unable to continue sign-in.' banners bury the current step.

11.why: Most screens show one green primary button, but step_04 presents two green buttons at once ('Create authenticator secret' plus 'Enable MFA and show recovery codes') and step_06 adds a second full-width action.

12.why: Happy-path screens explain what happened and what's next ('We sent a short-lived verification code…'), but failed actions yield only 'Unable to continue sign-in.' or a raw DOM exception with no next-step guidance.

13.why: Sign-in can be retried repeatedly without lockout and replacement recovery codes can be generated, but there is no resend-code link and no reveal/hide toggle for the password or codes.

14.why: Errors are either the vague 'Unable to continue sign-in.' or the raw technical dump 'Failed to execute insertBefore on Node…', neither of which states the problem or how to fix it.

15.why: Reading has no time limit, but the verification code is 'short-lived' and authenticator codes 'rotate every 30 seconds', giving a non-generous window to enter codes.
